name: budgetai-backend
description: BudgetAI Backend - MERN Stack Budget Management with AI

scripts.dev:all: npm run sync-env && concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:frontend: npm run sync-env && npm run build --prefix ../frontend
scripts.build:check: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const buildPath = path.join(__dirname, '../frontend/build'); if (!fs.existsSync(buildPath)) { console.error('Frontend build not found! Run: npm run build (from root) or cd frontend && npm run build'); process.exit(1); }"
